NSCameraUsageDescription.value: DocBrief AI can capture a document, whiteboard, or receipt photo for optional recognition review.

NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription.value: DocBrief AI imports document, whiteboard, or receipt photos you choose so you can review type and field suggestions before saving a brief.

NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.value: DocBrief AI uses the microphone so you can dictate a voice supplement for action titles, due dates, or spoken briefing questions before you Save or discard.

NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription.value: DocBrief AI uses on-device speech recognition to turn your voice supplement into editable action or briefing text that you review with Save or Not this.
